walletProviderTrustLists.description:
Trust lists containing trusted wallet providers.
Each entry MUST include either `verifierKey` or `verifierX509Der`.

signingKeyId.description: Key ID for signing access tokens. If unset, the default signing key is used.

authorizationServers.description: Dedicated managed authorization servers hosted by this issuer. At least one entry is required.

federation.description:
Optional OpenID Federation configuration used for trust evaluation.
When omitted, trust checks rely on existing LoTE trust-list behavior.

registrationCertificate.description:
Optional registration certificate configuration for issuer metadata (`issuer_info`).
Supports importing an existing JWT or generating one via registrar.

registrationCertificateCache.description: Server-managed cache for generated issuer registration certificates.

credentialResponseEncryption.description: Whether `credential_response_encryption` should be advertised in the credential issuer metadata.

credentialRequestEncryption.description: Whether `credential_request_encryption` should be advertised in the credential issuer metadata.

txCodeMaxAttempts.description: Maximum failed tx_code attempts before the pre-authorized code is invalidated. Defaults to 5.

tenant.description: The tenant that owns this object.

batchSize.description:
Value to determine the amount of credentials that are issued in a batch.
Default is 1.

dPopRequired.description: Indicates whether DPoP is required for the issuance process. Default value is true.

walletAttestationRequired.description:
Indicates whether wallet attestation is required for the token endpoint.
When enabled, wallets must provide OAuth-Client-Attestation headers.
Default value is false.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the VP request was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the VP request was last updated.
